verdict_text:
YES

The script drops blocks 2, 5, 8, maps the surviving indices in original order to 0..8 exactly as clause 2 requires, passes the 4 non-block tensors through untouched, and only writes after asserting that the surviving block index set is exactly {0..8} (which also rules out any block 9, 10, 11 tensor) and that the count is 121. Renumbering is a bijection on kept indices, so no collision can occur. One caveat outside the task spec proper: it depends on a local `_ckpt.load_checkpoint` helper rather than reading with `safetensors` directly, so it is only as standalone as that helper is.
